blocks.text: DSPM scans your Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud accounts to detect vulnerabilities and displays the scan results on the Resource Inventory page.

Vulnerability scanning is supported for both AWS-managed and customer-managed encryption. However, to support AWS-managed encryption, at least one customer-managed key should be present in the region.
DSPM supports the vulnerability scanning of AWS accounts in the supported AWS regions. To learn more, see Supported Data Stores, File Types, and Regions.
